rationale: Baseline computed as sum(annual_fault_rate * customers_interrupted * base_restoration_minutes) for each fault section, divided by total customers (SAIDI) or total customer-interruptions (CAIDI). With FCI: each section's restoration time reduced by max reduction from deployed FCI locations (n2, n4), floored at minimum_restoration_minutes=25. SAIFI unchanged because FCI deployment only affects restoration duration, not fault rate or customer count.
